prompt: The Sikh empire's capital at the time of the Battle of Sobraon came under the rule of the British Crown in what year?
answer: The capital, Lahore, came under British rule in **1849**, when the Punjab was annexed after the Second Anglo-Sikh War. (Direct rule by the British Crown began in **1858**, after the East India Company’s administration ended.)
